chunks.voc: 你 nǐ you; 好 hǎo good — 你好 nǐ hǎo is the whole greeting

chunks.tr: wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi chá
chunks.voc: 我 wǒ I; 想要 xiǎng yào would like; 杯 bēi the measure word for a cup of something; 茶 chá tea
chunks.en: I would like a cup of tea

chunks.voc: 好的 hǎo de all right, fine — the everyday yes
要 yào to want; 什么 shénme what — it stands where the answer would stand, so nothing else in the sentence moves
绿 lǜ green; 绿茶 lǜchá green tea
谢谢 xièxie thank you — the second syllable is toneless
请 qǐng please; 等 děng to wait; 一下 yíxià for a moment, which softens any verb it follows
两 liǎng two, before a measure word — 二 èr is for counting; 分钟 fēnzhōng minute; 就 jiù then, and no later than that
chunks.en: two minutes and it is ready

chunks.voc: 多少 duōshao how much; 钱 qián money — 多少钱 is the whole question
十 shí ten; 块 kuài the spoken measure word for the yuan, 元 yuán in writing
